questions.text: Remote Procedure Calls are used for
questions.solution:
RPC lets a program call a procedure in another address space, usually on another machine, but it can also be used between processes on the same machine. Since no single option is complete, the key marks "none of the above".

(This question was excluded from ISRO's evaluation because of its unclear wording.)

Answer: none of the above

NOTE: Question is excluded from the evaluation due to ambiguity.

options: communication between two processes remotely different from each other on the same system
communication between two processes on the same system
communication between two processes on the separate systems

questions.text: Assume that you have made a request for a web page through your web browser to a web server. Initially the browser cache is empty. Further, the browser is configured to send HTTP requests in non-persistent mode. The web page contains text and five very small images.The minimum number of TCP connections required to display the web page completely in your browser is__________.
questions.solution:
Non-persistent HTTP uses a separate TCP connection for each object: 1 for the HTML page + 5 for the images.

Answer: 6

questions.text: Which of the following protocol pairs can be used to send and retrieve e-mails (in that order)?
questions.solution:
SMTP is used to send (push) mail. POP3 (or IMAP) is used to retrieve mail from the mailbox. MIME is only a format for attachments.

Answer: SMTP, POP3

questions.text: Which protocol suite designed by IETF to provide security for a packet at the Internet layer?
questions.solution:
IPSec is the IETF protocol suite that secures packets at the IP (Internet) layer. SSL/TLS works above TCP.

Answer: IPSec
